$comment: SHARED CONTRACT -- the MAP EDITOR 2 seams. Authored 2026-08-05 DURING implementation,
across six parallel lanes, so that divergence is caught while it is still cheap.
Five seams, in the priority the lead PM set:
S1  DECLARATION VOCABULARY  server `map_overlay.orientation_declaration`
client `client2/src/map2/declaration.js frameFromDeclaration`
Rule N is portable; its CONSTANTS are not. Each side derives the no-evidence value
from its OWN reader, so the two can agree on the rule and still disagree on the
answer. That is exactly why this is a compared vector set and not a code review.
S2  COORDINATE ROUND TRIP AND THE BOUNDING-BOX BASIS
server `utils.coordinate_transformer.WaferMapCoordinateTransformer`
client `client2/src/map2/seating.js computeSeating` / `seatOf`
A stored coordinate is BBOX-RELATIVE. Any side that reverses it as
`cell = stored - start` is missing a term, and the shift differs between the
invert and non-invert branches, so a fixture exercising one branch under-reports.
S3  SCORING                 server `map_alignment.score_candidates` -- SERVER-vs-ORACLE,
not client-vs-server: the ruling of 2026-08-05 is that the server scores and the
client does not. The oracle is fixture data, and two of its constraints are
MEASURED, not preferences: per-candidate full-meta rebuild, and no percentage
anywhere.
S4  EXCEL FORM ROUND TRIP   client `client2/src/map2/excel_io.js` -- PENDING.
S5  align_applied.origin    server `map_overlay.align_applied_payload` -- pins the
CURRENT single-token behaviour so the approved three-way split has something to
diff against, and names the direction the client will fail in.
PROVENANCE DISCIPLINE. Every group carries `$source`, saying where its expected value
came from:
spec        -- docs/spec/MAP_ALIGNMENT_SPEC.md, written before either side was built
ruling      -- a lead PM decision recorded on a date, quoted here
measurement -- MEASURED on this DEVELOPMENT box, read-only, and labelled as such
No expected value in this file was copied out of whichever implementation was read first.
Where the two sides answer differently, this file records BOTH answers and asks the
question; it does not pick a winner. Deciding the contract is the lead PM's call.
SCALE IS NOT EVIDENCE OF DISCRIMINATION. The predecessor contract set `grid_y_invert` in
nine vectors, all `false`, all `rotation: 0, side: front` -- nine copies of the identity
frame, and no scorer read the field at all. Every case below carries `$kills`, naming the
wrong implementation it rejects. A case that cannot answer `$kills` does not belong here.
HOW TO RUN
server : conda run -n assy_manager python -m pytest contracts/map2_seam/ -q -rs
client : node contracts/map2_seam/client_harness.mjs
A green pytest run means THE SERVER meets the contract. The seam is scored only when both
commands have been run and both are green.
NO LINE NUMBERS IN `$why`. Anchors slide -- on 2026-07-29 a single extraction moved 274
lines by +26 and staled the contract, CODE_MAP and three test messages at once. Point at
function names.
PROOF THESE CHECKS CAN GO RED (2026-08-05). A green contract nobody has ever seen fail is
a green contract that may be measuring nothing. Seven defects were reverse-injected, in
process, with no repo file modified; each was caught by the named assertion:
server  start provenance decided by VALUE     -> test_start_axes_carry_no_indeterminate
_bucket + 4 census assertions
server  marker read with truthiness           -> orientation_agreement[marker_is_a_string]
server  bbox from grid dims, not the circle   -> 7 frame-basis assertions
server  candidate meta reused, not rebuilt    -> test_scoring_rebuilds_a_full_meta_per
_candidate (source rewritten and re-exec'd;
patching the CALLEE cannot model a defect
in the CALLER)
server  a coverage percentage in the payload  -> test_scoring_emits_no_percentage_anywhere
both    marker widened to cover a turned map  -> agreement[marked_but_turned], both scorers
client  a declared divergence partly resolved -> the frame-basis group fails in the
OPPOSITE direction and says to reclassify
The last one is the important one: it proves the named expected failure turns red when the
defect is FIXED, which is what keeps this from becoming a permanent anonymous red.

$axis_spelling.$why: 한 이음새에 두 어휘를 허용하지 않기 위한 유일한 매핑표. 서버는 meta 키 그대로 (`grid_y_invert`), 클라 Frame은 카멜 (`invertY`). 두 채점기가 각자 매핑표를 만들면 그 매핑표가 답의 두 번째 구현이 된다.
$axis_spelling.$note: This table is the ONLY place the two spellings are related. Both scorers read it from here.

$import_not_slice: Every client symbol above is reached by `import`, never by slicing source text.
MAP_ALIGNMENT_SPEC 0.3 rule (1): new code is a module -- takes arguments, returns values,
holds no module state -- so import-verifiability is guaranteed by construction and no
harness conversion work is required. The harness therefore has NO text-cutting step and
cannot die the way `split_registry_harness.mjs` died at U6 (five symbols deleted, the
extraction threw, and nobody knew for weeks).
It does still die on a RENAME -- an import of a symbol that no longer exists throws. That
is deliberate and the harness exits 2 with the missing name, rather than exiting 0 having

orientation_agreement_cases.$why: 양쪽이 **같은 답을 내야 하는** 방위 축 케이스. 규칙(Rule N)은 이식 가능하지만 상수는 각자 유도하므로, 규칙에 합의하고도 답이 갈릴 수 있다.
$source_detail: Rule N, as written in MAP_ALIGNMENT_SPEC section 0.3 note 2 and restated identically in
both implementations' headers: A STORED VALUE EQUAL TO WHAT THE READER INVENTS WHEN THE
KEY IS ABSENT IS NOT EVIDENCE THAT ANYONE CHOSE IT.
Lead PM ruling, 2026-08-05, on grid_start_x/y: PROVENANCE COMES FROM THE MARKER ONLY,
NEVER FROM THE VALUE. marked -> auto_registered; unmarked -> declared, whatever the
value; `indeterminate` never applies to start. Two reasons, both stated in the ruling:
the registrar writes start as an OBSERVED MINIMUM rather than a constant, so no value
test can identify one even in principle; and 0 of 668 production rows lack start, so the
premise of the absent-key inference is empty anyway.
Expected tokens below were derived from those two statements, NOT read out of either
implementation.
orientation_agreement_cases.$expect_shape: { <server meta key>: { value, source } } -- the client scorer translates the axis name through $axis_spelling and compares `frame.axes[<client name>].value` and `.source`.

cases.$why: 운영에서 가장 흔한 모양(258행). 표지가 있고 방위가 전부 등록기의 치역 안이다.
cases.$kills: An implementation that reads the marker AFTER the values -- it would answer `declared` on rotation 0 because the value is present and parseable, making the marker inert. That is the exact defect `geometry_declaration`'s docstring warns about, one axis over.

cases.$why: 운영 두 번째로 흔한 모양(117행). 표지가 없고 값이 전부 무증거 값이다 -- `indeterminate`가 존재하는 이유 그 자체.
cases.$kills: An implementation that folds this into `declared`. That is defect I4 -- a plausible default impersonating a declaration -- and it is what makes 196 rotation rows and 293 side rows silently authoritative. Also kills the opposite fold to `absent`: the keys are real and consumers use the values.
cases.$note: start_x/y = 1 here and is `declared` on BOTH axes despite equalling the server reader's absent-default of 1. That is the ruling, and it is the single case where start's marker-only rule is observable against the value rule.

cases.$why: 선언된 0. `v || dflt` 형태는 합법적인 0을 기본값으로 바꾼다 -- 벡터에 0을 반드시 넣는다.
cases.$kills: Any reader ending in `return v || dflt`. On the client that fold survives deliberately as `axes.startX.legacy`; if `frame.startX` were ever sourced from `legacy` instead of `value`, this case is the one that says so. It also kills a start implementation that applies the value test: 0 is the client's own absent-default, so a value test would answer `indeterminate` here and the ruling says `declared`.

cases.$why: 표지를 승계한 채 방위만 바꾼 맵. 표지의 권한은 축마다 다르다 -- 등록기는 90을 쓸 수 없으므로 여기서 auto_registered라 답하면 거짓이다.
cases.$kills: An implementation that lets the marker cover every axis unconditionally. It would answer `auto_registered` on rotation 90, i.e. `nobody measured this`, for a map somebody demonstrably turned -- and a consumer that refuses `auto_registered` would then refuse a correct declaration. Simultaneously kills the mirror error on start: 37 is NOT a registrar signature, but the ruling says the marker still explains it, so start stays `auto_registered`.

cases.$why: 표지가 문자열 `"true"`. 진리값이 아니면 표지가 아니다.
cases.$kills: An implementation using truthiness on the marker (`if m.get('auto_registered')` / `if (m.auto_registered)`). Truthiness reads the string `"false"` as a present marker too, which would silently demote every declared axis on such a row to `auto_registered`.

cases.$why: `"Back"`은 조용히 front가 되는 값이다. 값이 아니라 파싱 실패로 답해야 한다.
cases.$kills: An implementation passing the string through (`side === 'back' ? 'back' : 'front'`), which answers `front`/`declared` for `"Back"` -- a map declared back-side, read front-side, with a provenance token asserting somebody chose front. Every cell mirrors.
cases.$expect_note: The y axis here is a real boolean `false` and both sides answer `indeterminate` -- one unparsable axis must not taint its neighbours. That is part of what this case kills: a whole-meta verdict rather than a per-axis one.

cases.$why: `"rear"`는 어휘 밖이다. 두 단어 어휘를 벗어난 값은 unparsable이다.
cases.$kills: Same as `side_wrong_case` but for a value that is not a case variation -- an implementation whitelisting only case-folding would let `rear` through as front.
cases.$partial: Only the axes listed are compared. Use this form when a case exists to discriminate one axis.

cases.$why: `grid_y_invert: 2`. 참/거짓을 담은 표현이 아니면 읽힌 것이 아니다.
cases.$kills: `bool(raw)` / `!!raw`. Truthiness answers `true`/`declared` for 2, so a map with a junk y-invert would be drawn mirrored and the token would assert somebody chose it.

cases.$why: `1`은 참/거짓을 진짜로 담은 표현이다. 2와 갈려야 한다.
cases.$kills: An implementation that rejects every non-boolean (which would make 1 `unparsable` and lose a real declaration), and equally one that accepts every integer (which would make 2 `declared`). Paired with `yinv_int_two` this pins the boundary rather than the direction.

cases.$why: `" 90 "`. 공백 패딩된 수치 문자열은 읽혀야 한다 -- CSV 인제션이 만든다.
cases.$kills: A strict `isinstance(raw, int)` reader, which would answer `unparsable`/0 for a map that plainly declares a quarter turn, refusing an alignment that should have succeeded.

cases.$why: 메타 자체가 없다. 다섯 축 전부 `absent`이고 다섯 축 전부 응답에 있어야 한다.
cases.$kills: An implementation returning null / an empty dict for a null meta. `frameFromMeta`'s `return null` is exactly that, and a caller cannot refuse what it cannot observe. VALUE is deliberately NOT compared here -- the two sides substitute different start defaults and that divergence is recorded separately in `orientation_divergence_cases`.

cases.$why: 🔴 **이 케이스 하나가 `frame_confirmed_from`이 존재하는 이유 전부다.** 씨앗 단위의 확정 승자는 `rot0_front`, 즉 **정확히 무증거 쌍**이라, 확정을 표지 없이 쓰면 나오는 행이 아무도 손대지 않은 맵의 행과 **바이트 동일**해진다. 표지가 없으면 규칙 N이 그 위를 덮어써 `indeterminate`(「아무도 고른 증거가 없다」)를 내고 확정은 관측 불가능해진다. y반전과 start는 확정 대상이 아니므로 표지가 있어도 그대로 채점된다 — 축 셋을 한 표지로 덮으면 확정된 적 없는 축이 확정을 사칭한다.
cases.$kills: A port with no frame-confirmation branch. Measured on the client before 2026-08-06: rotation and side came back `indeterminate` on a frame a human had just confirmed -- the screen saying nobody decided anything about the one axis somebody did decide. It also kills a port that applies the marker to all five axes: `grid_y_invert` and `grid_start_*` must keep their own tokens here, and a port that overwrote y-invert would change what the confirmed rotation and side MEAN, since they are expressed relative to it.

cases.$why: 확정 표지와 등록기 표지가 함께 있는 행. 확정 쓰기는 방위 축의 등록기 표지를 지우지 않으므로 둘이 공존한다. 회전·면은 확정이 이기고, **나머지 세 축은 등록기 그대로**다 — 확정이 덮은 것은 그 둘뿐이기 때문이지 서열 때문이 아니다.
cases.$kills: A port that lets one marker win the whole meta. Answering `auto_registered` on rotation/side erases the confirmation; answering `confirmed` on y-invert and start claims a confirmation that never happened on axes nothing ever scored. Both directions are silent, and the row looks identical either way.

cases.$why: 확정 표지 아래에 **읽히지 않는** 면 값(`"Back"`)이 있다. 확정이 「읽을 수 없는 값」을 확정으로 승격시키면 그것이 정확히 이 어휘가 막는 사칭이다. 값도 표지를 얻지 못하고 대체값으로 떨어진다. ⚠️ 회전은 **키가 아예 없는데도** `absent`가 아니라 `unparsable`이 된다 — 확정 분기가 부재와 파싱실패를 한데 접기 때문이고, 같은 어휘의 `absent_key_is_not_unparsable`과 나란히 놓으면 어색하다. 서버의 성질이므로 **그대로 옮긴다**(총괄 보고 대상).
cases.$kills: A port that stamps `confirmed` on whatever is in the key. `"Back"` would become a confirmed declaration of the back side while the server reads it as front -- every row of the map mirrored between the two answers, with a confirmation record vouching for it. Also kills a port that 'improves' the absent/unparsable collapse: the two sides must answer the same word, and a port that corrects the side it is porting is a second implementation.

cases.$why: 🔴 **표지가 있는데 비어 있다.** 쓰는 쪽이 실제로 만들 수 있는 모양이다 — `confirmed_meta_for`의 마지막 줄이 `dict(mark or {})`라, 신원 없이 확정을 쓰면 `{}`가 저장된다. 서버는 `bool(m.get(...))`로 읽으므로 **자기 표지를 무시**하고(파이썬 `bool({})`는 거짓), 이는 「`confirmation_uid`가 없으면 표지 자격이 없다」는 서버 규칙과 일관된다. 그런데 자바스크립트 `!!{}`는 **참**이다.
cases.$kills: A port that reads markers with `!!`. It answers `confirmed` on precisely the rows the server treats as unmarked -- a divergence manufactured by the fix for a divergence, and invisible because the marker IS there. This was already live for `phys_assumed_from` before the confirmation work; the case pins all three markers to one truthiness rule.

orientation_divergence_cases.$why: **두 구현이 서로 다른 답을 내는 자리.** 합의가 아니므로 합의로 채점하지 않는다 -- 양쪽 답을 각각 고정하고 질문을 총괄에 넘긴다. 여기 있는 케이스가 초록이라는 것은 「두 구현이 오늘 이렇게 갈려 있다」는 뜻이지 「괜찮다」는 뜻이 아니다.
orientation_divergence_cases.$source_detail: MEASURED 2026-08-05 on this DEVELOPMENT box by calling both implementations on the metas below. Development box only -- says nothing about production. None of these shapes occurs in the 668 rows currently in this box's `wafer_map_metadata` (all 23 production shapes agree; see `orientation_census`), so these are reachable-by-shape, not observed-in-the-wild.
orientation_divergence_cases.$ruling_pending: The lead PM decides which side is the contract. Until then both answers are pinned and this group is scored as DIVERGENCE, printed as such by both scorers, and blocks round completion rather than the suite.

cases.$why: `"3.7"`. 서버 `int("3.7")`은 ValueError, 클라 `parseInt("3.7", 10)`은 3.
cases.$failure_scenario: The server substitutes its absent-default 1 and reports `unparsable`; the client reports a declared start of 3. `computeSeating` subtracts startX from every stored coordinate, so the two sides differ by 2 cells on every cell in the map, and the client's token asserts the value was chosen.
cases.$client_changed_2026_08_05: client half was {"value":3,"source":"declared"}; the parse-direction fix (strict int/float readers, normalise-or-refuse) moved it to {"value":0,"source":"unparsable"}. The SOURCE now agrees with the server; what remains is only the start-default disagreement (client reads an absent start as 0, server as 1), which is boarded separately and does not belong to this case.

cases.$why: `"3abc"`. `parseInt`은 앞부분만 읽고 멈춘다.
cases.$failure_scenario: Identical to `start_float_string`. Listed separately because it kills a different fix: normalising `"3.7"` by rounding would leave `"3abc"` still divergent.

$source_detail: MAP_ALIGNMENT_SPEC section 2.3 and layer (2): A STORED COORDINATE IS BOUNDING-BOX
RELATIVE, and the box's basis is not in `grid_metadata` -- it hangs off an edge pointing
at another map. The forward convention is quoted in the spec as `xv = c - box.minC +
start_x`, and its y-invert branch as `yv = max_r - r + start_y`.
The reverse -- which is what a seating layer computes -- is therefore:
c = xv - start_x + box.minC
r = (invert) ? box.maxR - (yv - start_y) : yv - start_y + box.minR
then the frame rotation/side map (`cell_to_physical` / `seatOf`).
This expectation is NOT copied from `WaferMapCoordinateTransformer`. It is the spec's
convention, re-derived. The server implementation corroborates it; the corroboration is
recorded, not used as the source. PROOF THE VECTOR IS LIVE: a counterfactual
implementation carrying ONLY the two missing terms, laid on top of the client's own
`seatOf`, was measured 2026-08-05 to reproduce the server's answer on 0 mismatches out
of 3430 cells across all four fixtures below. The expectation therefore identifies
exactly two terms and nothing else.
$why_these_fixtures: Four, not nine, and each answers a different question:
SPEC_FIXTURE      -- the spec's own measured fixture, non-invert. Non-centred box
(minR 1 of 19 rows), so the box term is OBSERVABLE. Nine
identity-frame vectors could not see it.
SPEC_FIXTURE_YINV -- the SAME geometry with the mirror on. Section 2.3 measures that
the shift DIFFERS between the two branches, so a fixture
exercising one branch under-reports the other.
CORE_YINV_LIKE    -- shaped after production row `CORE_YINV`: y-inverted, offset (5,5),
one of the five rows where raw and prod paths disagree, and the
one row where the two open unknowns of section 2 meet.
ROT90_BACK        -- a quarter turn AND a side flip, so the cols/rows swap and the
offset sign flip in `_frame_phys_params` are both live. Shaped
All four have a NON-CENTRED bounding box, measured. A centred box makes the term zero

$scored_how.server: Builds the transformer through `map_overlay._frame_phys_params` (never raw meta values -- the spec measures that one bbox with 8 transforms on top misplaces `CORE_YINV` by (2,-1)) and asserts the bbox, then round-trips every cell.
$scored_how.client: Imports `computeSeating` and `seatOf` and asks them for the seat of the same stored coordinate.

scoring_invariants.$why: **서버 대 오라클.** 총괄 확정 2026-08-05: 서버가 채점하고 클라는 채점하지 않는다. 그러므로 이 이음새는 클라-서버가 아니다 -- 후보 열거와 시프트 해를 독립적으로 유도한 픽스처가 오라클이다.
$source_detail: Both constraints below are MEASURED facts recorded in MAP_ALIGNMENT_SPEC, not stylistic
preferences:
FULL-META REBUILD (section 2, THE PREMISE). A candidate enumerator must build each
candidate as a WHOLE meta and re-derive the bounding box through the production path.
Deriving one box and stacking 8 transforms on it prevents the cancellation between the
y mirror and the offset sign flip in `_frame_phys_params`, and production row
`CORE_YINV` is measured to land (2,-1) off when that happens.
NO PERCENTAGE ANYWHERE (section 3). Measured on an asymmetric 376-die mask, a
candidate that was CORRECTLY ORIENTED but one cell off scored 94% and ranked BELOW
three WRONGLY ORIENTED candidates at 98, 97 and 95%. A coverage percentage provably
inverts the ranking. The vectors therefore carry absolute counts and a margin in dies.
scoring_invariants.$scored_how: Server only. There is no client counterpart and, by the ruling, there must not be one -- a client scorer would be the second implementation of the answer. `client_harness.mjs` asserts the ABSENCE of a client scorer instead: no module under client2/src/map2/ may export a candidate-scoring function. That is a duplicate guard, not a round trip.

invariants.assert: no key in any scored candidate, in the ruling, or in the stats block matches /pct|percent|ratio|coverage/i, and no float value in a candidate lies strictly between 0 and 1 exclusive except `elapsed_ms`.

invariants.assert: every scored candidate's `margin` is an int (or null when not scorable), and equals `agreement` minus the highest `agreement` among the OTHER seven.

The new client has no bounding box at all, so there is no mask basis on the new side to compare -- the divergence recorded in `frame_basis_cases.client_expected_failure` supersedes it and is strictly larger. Restated: THE MASK-VERSUS-CIRCLE DIVERGENCE EXISTS ONLY IN THE LEGACY CLIENT, and the legacy client is frozen by product-owner ruling. This contract pins the new client instead, as instructed.
axes.what_would_score_it: The new client growing a bounding box. When it does, the basis question returns and this contract needs a resolving `valid_die_ref` case -- authored below as `frame_basis_valid_die_pending`.

frame_basis_valid_die_pending.$why: 새 클라가 상자를 갖게 되는 날 곧바로 물어야 하는 질문. 지금 쓰지 않으면 그날 아무도 안 쓴다.
frame_basis_valid_die_pending.$status: PENDING -- no bounding box exists in client2/src/map2/ to score.
frame_basis_valid_die_pending.$question: When a map declares `valid_die_ref` AND it resolves, is the box the VALID-DIE MASK's bbox or the WAFER CIRCLE's? The legacy client answers mask; the server answers circle and has no mask concept at all. Measured 165 of 165 cells shift, and the shift DIFFERS between the invert and non-invert branches -- non-invert inherits the top trim, invert inherits the bottom trim -- so a fixture exercising one branch under-reports the other. A resolving-ref case must therefore come in a PAIR.
frame_basis_valid_die_pending.$kills: A new client that copies the legacy mask basis without the seam being re-decided, and equally one that copies the server circle basis and silently changes what every existing stored coordinate means.
frame_basis_valid_die_pending.$note: MAP_ALIGNMENT_SPEC section 2.3 states this is not a transform defect but a MISSING LAYER: the box's basis is not in `grid_metadata` at all, it hangs off an edge pointing at another map. Whichever side wins, the answer has to be carried, not assumed.

geometry_declaration_cases.$why: 맵 하나의 **물리 기하 출처** 한 낱말. 축별 방위(`orientation_agreement_cases`)와는 다른 질문이라 그 케이스들이 이것을 잡지 못한다 — 실측으로 확인: 클라 포트에서 빌림 분기를 지워도 방위 케이스는 전부 초록이었다. 서버 `geometry_declaration`, 클라 `geometryDeclaration`.

cases.$why: 여섯 키가 전부 수이고 표지가 없다. 기준선.
cases.$kills: A port that returns absent on a well-formed spec, or one that demands a marker before it will say declared.

cases.$why: 표지가 있고 값도 형식은 온전하다.
cases.$kills: An implementation that reads the VALUES BEFORE THE MARKER: it answers declared because chip 1x1 parses, which makes the marker inert. That is the synthetic-spec defect in miniature, and it is why both sides state marker-before-values.

cases.$why: 정렬 채점기가 만드는 사본 — 여섯 키는 바닥의 실측값이고 `phys_assumed_from`이 출처를 나른다. **저장되지 않으므로** 클라는 이 모양을 DB에서 만날 수 없지만, 포트에 분기가 빠지면 서버가 처음 넘겨 준 순간 답이 갈린다.
cases.$kills: A port MISSING THE BORROW BRANCH. The six values are real measurements, so it falls through to declared and the borrow impersonates a declaration — the exact thing the assumed token was added to prevent. Silent on both sides.

cases.$why: 빌린 사본이 등록기 표지를 물려받은 경우. 방위 축의 출처는 여전히 등록기 것이라 표지를 지우지 않으며, 그래서 두 표지가 공존한다. 기하 축에서는 빌림이 이긴다 — 아래 여섯 값은 더 이상 등록기가 쓴 것이 아니기 때문이다.
cases.$kills: A port that checks the registrar marker FIRST. It answers auto_registered on a copy whose spec is the measured one it borrowed, so the alignment screen calls a map it has just scored unscorable.

cases.$why: 키 하나가 없다. 부재와 형식 실패는 수리가 다르다.
cases.$kills: A port that collapses absent into unparsable, sending the operator to fix the format of a value that is not there.

cases.$why: 키는 있는데 수가 아니다.
cases.$kills: A port using a coercion that turns a non-numeric string into 0 and reports declared. The client historically accepted input the server refuses.

cases.$why: 확정된 정렬 아래에서 기준 맵으로부터 파생한 기하. 여섯 값은 **바닥의 실측값**이고 형식도 온전하므로 표지를 안 보면 그대로 `declared`가 된다. `assumed`와 결정적으로 다른 점 하나: 이 모양은 **저장된다**(`frame_confirmation.record_confirmation` → `map_alignment.confirmed_meta_for`가 `wafer_map_metadata` 행에 쓴다). 그래서 클라는 이것을 DB에서 직접 읽는다 — 어휘에 낱말만 넣고 분기를 안 넣으면 잠재 어긋남이 아니라 **당장의** 어긋남이다.
cases.$kills: A port MISSING THE CONFIRMATION BRANCH. The six values are the floor's real measurements, so it falls through to `declared` and states that somebody measured this map -- on the one row whose entire content is that nobody did. Measured on the client before 2026-08-06: `geometryDeclaration` returned 'declared' here while the server returned 'confirmed', and nothing was red. Also kills a port that maps the token to a refusal: the server scores this map happily (`geometry_computable` returns None), so refusing it makes the screen contradict a run that succeeded.

cases.$why: 확정 표지와 등록기 표지가 함께 있는 행. 등록기 표지는 지워지지 않는다(방위 축의 출처는 여전히 등록기 것이다) — 그런데 기하 여섯 키는 확정 아래 바닥에서 파생된 값이라 더 이상 등록기가 쓴 합성값이 아니다. `borrow_marker_outranks_the_registrar_marker`와 같은 이유, 다른 표지.
cases.$kills: A port that checks the registrar marker FIRST. It answers `auto_registered` on a row whose spec is the floor's measured one, so the screen calls a map unscorable on the grounds of a synthetic 1x1 chip -- while the values sitting there are 7x8.

cases.$why: 두 표지가 한 dict에 같이 있는 **메모리 사본** — 확정된 값을 다시 빌린 경우다. 저장되는 행에는 둘이 같이 붙지 않는다(확정 쓰기가 빌림 표지를 대체한다). 합쳐진 것은 가장 약한 기여자를 따라가므로(스펙 §0.2 ⑨) 빌림이 이긴다. 순서가 곧 서열이라는 것을 고정하는 자리다.
cases.$kills: A port that puts the confirmation branch FIRST because `confirmed` sounds stronger than `assumed`. It reports a value that was borrowed again -- on nobody's authority this time -- as one that stands under a recorded confirmation, which is the strongest claim in the vocabulary attached to the weakest evidence.

cases.$why: 회전·면만 확정하고 웨이퍼·칩 기하는 이 맵이 스스로 선언한 경우. 표지가 둘인 이유가 여기 있다 — 사실이 둘이기 때문이지 대칭 때문이 아니다. `geometry_declaration`이 답하는 질문은 「이 맵의 **물리** 기하가 선언인가」 하나뿐이고, 프레임 확정은 그 질문에 대한 답이 아니다.
cases.$kills: A port that folds the two confirmation markers into one check. It answers `confirmed` on a spec somebody actually measured, which erases a real declaration -- the mirror image of the impersonation the token was added to stop, and just as invisible. Also kills a port that treats ANY key starting `*_confirmed_from` as the geometry marker.

cases.$why: 🔴 표지 키는 있는데 값이 비어 있다 — `confirmed_meta_for`의 `dict(mark or {})`가 실제로 만드는 모양이다. 파이썬 `bool({})`는 거짓이라 서버는 자기 표지를 무시하고 여섯 값을 그대로 읽어 `declared`를 낸다. 자바스크립트 `!!{}`는 참이다. `phys_assumed_from`에 대해 이 어긋남은 확정 작업 **이전부터 살아 있었다**(실측 2026-08-06: 서버 `declared`, 클라 `assumed`).
cases.$kills: A port that reads markers with `!!` instead of Python's truthiness. It reports a borrowed or confirmed geometry on exactly the rows the server treats as unmarked -- and it is invisible in review because the marker IS present, so the code reads correct. Pins one truthiness rule across all three markers rather than a second rule per marker.
